description: Energy-train and material-boundary templates for metals, cement, glass, chemicals, batteries, minerals, and circular processing.

doe-industrial-decarbonization-roadmap.title: U.S. DOE Industrial Decarbonization Roadmap
doe-industrial-decarbonization-roadmap.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-industrial-decarbonization-roadmap.applicable_boundary: Industrial process and decarbonization pathway taxonomy for iron and steel, chemicals, refining, cement, and cross-cutting systems
doe-industrial-decarbonization-roadmap.note: Technology names and boundary prompts are derived from public sector taxonomies; no roadmap performance values are copied.

doe-industrial-liftoff.title: U.S. DOE Pathways to Commercial Liftoff: Industrial Decarbonization
doe-industrial-liftoff.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-industrial-liftoff.applicable_boundary: Processing and production emissions for chemicals, refining, iron and steel, food, pulp and paper, cement, aluminum, and glass
doe-industrial-liftoff.note: This pack provides no commercial-readiness, cost, or performance assumptions.

doe-steel-eaf-waste-heat-profile.title: U.S. DOE Waste Heat Recovery: Technology and Opportunities in U.S. Industry
doe-steel-eaf-waste-heat-profile.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-steel-eaf-waste-heat-profile.applicable_boundary: Electricity supplied to an electric-arc furnace per short ton of liquid steel
doe-steel-eaf-waste-heat-profile.note: The report gives 1.5 million Btu/short ton average furnace power input and 1.388 million with scrap preheat. Fuel and upstream electricity losses are excluded.

doe-aluminum-bandwidth-2017.title: DOE Bandwidth Study on Energy Use in U.S. Aluminum Manufacturing
doe-aluminum-bandwidth-2017.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-aluminum-bandwidth-2017.applicable_boundary: On-site process energy per mass of aluminum for selected U.S. aluminum-manufacturing subareas
doe-aluminum-bandwidth-2017.note: Current-typical and practical-minimum intensities are macro-scale 2010 estimates, not facility measurements. Feedstock energy and off-site generation losses are excluded.

doe-aluminum-energy-requirements.title: U.S. DOE Energy Requirements for Aluminum Production
doe-aluminum-energy-requirements.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-aluminum-energy-requirements.applicable_boundary: Electric induction-furnace input to heat absorbed in secondary aluminum melting
doe-aluminum-energy-requirements.note: The report states approximately 90% induction-melting efficiency and identifies capacity and oxide-management limitations.

doe-netl-compressor-model-2024.title: FECM/NETL Natural Gas with Hydrogen Pipeline Cost Model: Description and User's Manual
doe-netl-compressor-model-2024.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-netl-compressor-model-2024.applicable_boundary: Electric motor input through compressor shaft to isentropic gas-compression work
doe-netl-compressor-model-2024.note: The model uses 85% compressor isentropic efficiency and 96% motor efficiency; their product is a generic screening proxy, not a synthesis-loop measurement.

carrier.label: Minimum chemical-transformation work
carrier.basis: reversible minimum work for caller-declared reactants, products, states, and environment
carrier.boundary: Minimum reversible transformation work, not product heating or actual plant energy

carrier.label: Minimum separation work
carrier.basis: reversible minimum work for caller-declared feed, product, and tailings compositions
carrier.boundary: Minimum reversible separation work, not actual process energy

technology.label: Hydrogen direct-reduced-iron reduction train
technology.boundary: Hydrogen chemical exergy to declared minimum iron-oxide reduction work; heating, compression, electricity, off-gas, and material streams are separate

technology.label: Natural-gas direct-reduced-iron reduction train
technology.boundary: Selected natural-gas chemical exergy to minimum reduction work; reforming, heat, electricity, and material streams must be explicit

technology.label: Blast-furnace reduction train
technology.boundary: Selected reductant chemical energy to minimum reduction work; complete assessment requires all material and utility flows

technology.label: Electric-arc-furnace melting train
technology.boundary: Electrical input to declared molten-metal heat service; reaction inputs, off-gas, slag, dust, and auxiliary energy are separate

technology.label: Molten-oxide electrolysis
technology.boundary: Electrical input to minimum electrochemical transformation work; heat and all material streams remain explicit

technology.label: Hall-Heroult aluminum electrolysis
technology.boundary: Cell electricity to minimum electrochemical transformation work; anodes, heat, gases, and materials are separate

technology.label: Alumina-refining separation auxiliaries
technology.boundary: Selected electrical auxiliaries to minimum separation work; digestion heat, steam, calcination, reagents, and materials are separate

technology.label: Electric cement calciner
technology.boundary: Electricity to declared calcination heat; carbonate reaction, process CO2, solids, and exhaust are separate

technology.label: Oxyfuel cement kiln heat train
technology.boundary: Selected kiln fuel to useful high-temperature heat; oxygen production, calcination, solids, capture, and exhaust are separate

technology.label: Electric glass melter
technology.boundary: Electricity to declared glass-melt heat; batch reactions, cullet, off-gas, and material losses are separate

technology.label: Electric lime calciner
technology.boundary: Electricity to declared calcination heat; reaction and process CO2 require material accounting

technology.label: Ammonia synthesis-loop compressor
technology.boundary: Electrical input to synthesis-gas compression work; reaction, separation, heating, and feedstocks are separate

efficiency.statistic: Product of 85% compressor and 96% motor default efficiencies
efficiency.range_basis: Published point assumptions; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Electric motor-driven centrifugal gas compressor used as a synthesis-loop proxy
applicability.boundary: Electricity to isentropic compression work; reaction and separation excluded

efficiency.note: Ammonia recycle composition, pressure ratio, staging, and turndown require a compressor map.

technology.label: Methanol synthesis-loop compressor
technology.boundary: Electrical input to synthesis-loop compression work; reaction and separation are separate

efficiency.statistic: Product of 85% compressor and 96% motor default efficiencies
efficiency.range_basis: Published point assumptions; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Electric motor-driven centrifugal gas compressor used as a synthesis-loop proxy
applicability.boundary: Electricity to isentropic compression work; reaction and separation excluded

efficiency.note: Methanol recycle composition, pressure ratio, staging, and turndown require a compressor map.

technology.label: Ethylene steam-cracker furnace
technology.boundary: Selected furnace fuel to coil heat; feedstock reaction, dilution steam, products, and downstream separation are separate

technology.label: Mineral grinding circuit
technology.boundary: Electrical input to declared comminution work; size distribution and throughput are required for process interpretation

technology.label: Froth-flotation auxiliaries
technology.boundary: Selected electricity to minimum mineral-separation work; reagents, air, water, and all material streams are separate

technology.label: Hydrometallurgical separation auxiliaries
technology.boundary: Selected electrical auxiliaries to minimum separation work; reagents, reaction heat, water, products, and residues are separate

technology.label: Battery cathode-material kiln
technology.boundary: Electricity to declared material-heating duty; reaction, atmosphere, yield, and off-gas require material flows

technology.label: Mechanical recycling line
technology.boundary: Selected electricity to minimum separation work; washing, drying, material yields, and rejected fractions are separate

technology.label: Chemical-recycling reactor heat train
technology.boundary: Selected electricity to reactor heat; reaction products, solvents, fuel, char, and off-gas are separate

technology.label: Secondary-metal remelting furnace
technology.boundary: Selected electricity to molten-metal heat; oxidation, dross, slag, fuel, and product composition are separate

efficiency.range_basis: Published point approximation; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Coreless induction furnace remelting secondary aluminum
applicability.boundary: Furnace electricity to heat absorbed by molten aluminum; holding and material losses outside

efficiency.note: Only applicable to induction remelting; other metals and furnace types require an override.

intensity.label: Electric-arc-furnace electricity per liquid-steel output
intensity.boundary: Furnace electrical input per metric tonne of liquid steel; fuels, oxygen production, alloying, casting, upstream electricity losses, and material yield are excluded

specific_energy.source_version: DOE industrial waste-heat report Table A2.12
specific_energy.statistic: Published average power input converted from 1.5 million Btu/short ton
specific_energy.range_basis: Published scrap-preheat and no-scrap-preheat inputs converted to MWh per metric tonne

applicability.technology: Electric arc furnace producing liquid steel
applicability.boundary: Furnace electricity per liquid-steel mass; upstream electricity and auxiliary material/energy inputs excluded

specific_energy.note: Mass yield and tap practice must match; this is input intensity, not thermal efficiency.

intensity.label: Hall-Heroult on-site electrolysis energy per aluminum output
intensity.boundary: On-site electrolysis energy per metric tonne of aluminum; alumina refining, anodes, casting, feedstock energy, and off-site electricity losses are excluded

specific_energy.statistic: Current-typical 23,388 Btu/lb converted to MWh per metric tonne

applicability.boundary: On-site electrolysis energy per aluminum mass; upstream and other process areas excluded

specific_energy.note: The lower value is a practical-minimum technology case, not statistical uncertainty.

intensity.label: Secondary-aluminum melting and casting energy per output
intensity.boundary: On-site secondary melting and casting energy per metric tonne of aluminum; scrap preparation, upstream energy losses, and later shape production are excluded

specific_energy.statistic: Current-typical 2,229 Btu/lb converted to MWh per metric tonne

applicability.technology: U.S. secondary-aluminum melting and casting subarea
applicability.boundary: On-site mixed energy per secondary-aluminum mass; upstream losses excluded

specific_energy.note: Carrier mix is not inferred; provide site-specific electricity and fuel shares for emissions or exergy work.

material_templates.label: Ironmaking feed-product balance
material_templates.boundary: Ore, reductant, flux, recycled solids, iron product, slag, dust, and off-gas across the declared ironmaking unit

material_templates.label: Steelmaking feed-product balance
material_templates.boundary: Hot metal, DRI, scrap, flux, oxygen, carbon, liquid steel, slag, dust, off-gas, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Cement-clinker material and process-CO2 balance
material_templates.boundary: Raw meal, fuels and ash, clinker, dust, bypass, exhaust species, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Primary-aluminum material balance
material_templates.boundary: Alumina, anodes, bath additions, liquid aluminum, cell gases, dust, spent lining, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Glass-melting material balance
material_templates.boundary: Virgin batch, cullet, additives, glass product, volatilization, dust, off-gas, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Ammonia-synthesis material balance
material_templates.boundary: Hydrogen, nitrogen, purge and recycle streams, ammonia product, inerts, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Methanol-synthesis material balance
material_templates.boundary: Syngas feed, recycle, purge, crude methanol, water, byproducts, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Mineral-beneficiation material balance
material_templates.boundary: Ore, water, reagents, concentrate, tailings, recovered water, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Battery-material processing balance
material_templates.boundary: Precursors or recovered feed, reagents, solvents, active-material product, residues, off-gas, wastewater, and inventory change

material_templates.label: Recycling sortation and yield balance
material_templates.boundary: Mixed feed, recovered product fractions, rejects, contamination, wash streams, and inventory change

metadata.default_policy: explicit process performance and complete material inventories required
metadata.process_emissions_note: Calcination, reduction, electrode consumption, and reaction emissions must remain separate from combustion inventories.
